name: 922 LST Organizer
description: Gathers a 922 batch's tube .lst files, files each into its source-material folder, and writes one color-coded PDF report reconciling the PO's tube count against what was pulled. Unresolvable files go to a Needs Review folder.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder and know the batch number.
The batch needs its QF-QU-09 PO workbook in the Documentation folder, and the tube .lst files under the order folders' 7000 folders.
how_it_works: The app gathers the batch's tube .lst files and files each into a folder by source material.
It reconciles the PO's tube count (total, oversized, target standard) against what was actually pulled, resolving odd filenames and order-folder fallbacks.
A trailing revision letter counts as the same piece in either direction, so a PO line reading '-4' still matches a file named '-4A-STEP' (and vice versa) instead of being reported as missing.
output: Tube .lst files sorted into per-material folders, a color-coded 'LST Report - Batch {n}.pdf' reconciliation, and a Needs Review folder for anything unresolved.
